S1; S2 two parallel clauses|S1; however, S2|a comma alone cannot join two complete sentences|therefore/thus express result|meanwhile/moreover express simultaneity or addition

column3: 这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。

# title: 「这个计划听起来不错;但是,成本太高了。」的正确英文是?
Compound sentences and semicolons · 专项练习: The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.|The plan sounds good; moreover, it costs too much.|The plan sounds good; therefore, it costs too much.|The plan sounds good; besides, it costs too much.
column4: 考查Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。正确句:The plan sounds good; however, it costs too much.
